question: How many isomorphism and complement-isomorphism classes occur among the 22 independently replayed E=2 candidates?
audit_rules: Re-enumerate all five-sets and require exactly two same-colour conflicts with four common vertices.
Canonicalize every graph and complement with nauty labelg's dense representation.
Require the dense and sparse equivalence partitions to agree exactly before reporting class counts.
claim_boundary: Any result classifies only this fixed 22-candidate corpus and cannot imply a global order-43 classification.
